Vercel CLI 65.11.0
▲ vercel env list [options]
List all Environment Variables for a Project

Options:
  -e, --environment <ENVIRONMENT>  List only the variables for this environment
  --git-branch <BRANCH>            List only the variables for this Git branch
  --guidance                       Receive command suggestions once command is
                                   complete
  --json                           Output as JSON, including readable
                                   Environment Variable values
  -p, --project <NAME_OR_ID>       Project name or ID (default: linked project)

Global Options: See `vercel --help`
